mapper.select: SELECT id AS returnId, return_no AS returnNo, status, reason, approved_amount AS approvedAmount, approved_at AS approvedAt FROM xsy_order_return WHERE deleted = FALSE AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT source_id AS returnId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM xsy_finance_receivable WHERE deleted = FALSE AND order_id = #{orderId} AND source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND entry_type = 'RED' GROUP BY source_id

SELECT rf.id AS refundId, rf.return_id AS returnId, rt.return_no AS returnNo, rf.refund_no AS refundNo, rf.status, rf.refund_amount AS refundAmount, rf.completed_at AS completedAt FROM xsy_order_refund rf LEFT JOIN xsy_order_return rt ON rt.id = rf.return_id AND rt.deleted = FALSE WHERE rf.deleted = FALSE AND rf.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY rf.created_at DESC, rf.id DESC

SELECT order_refund_id AS refundId, COUNT(*) AS sourceCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeededCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failedCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PROCESSING') AS processingCount, COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED'), 0) AS succeededAmount FROM xsy_refund_funding_allocation WHERE deleted = FALSE AND order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY order_refund_id

SELECT facts.refund_id AS refundId, COUNT(*) AS sourceCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE facts.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeededCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE facts.status = 'FAILED') AS failedCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE facts.status = 'PROCESSING') AS processingCount, COALESCE(SUM(facts.amount) FILTER (WHERE facts.status = 'SUCCEEDED'), 0) AS succeededAmount FROM ( SELECT p.source_id AS refund_id, CASE WHEN p.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE p.status END AS status, p.provider_amount AS amount FROM xsy_payment_refund p JOIN xsy_order_refund rf ON rf.id = p.source_id AND rf.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND rf.order_id = #{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT m.source_id AS refund_id, 'SUCCEEDED' AS status, m.amount FROM xsy_customer_balance_movement m JOIN xsy_order_refund rf ON rf.id = m.source_id AND rf.deleted = FALSE WHERE m.deleted = FALSE AND m.type = 'REFUND' AND m.direction = 'CREDIT' AND m.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND rf.order_id = #{orderId} ) facts GROUP BY facts.refund_id
